notes.title: Outbreak: Shades of Horror Early Access Version Launches on October 24th!
notes.content:
Hey Survivors!

We are excited to announce the official roadmap for [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b]’s initial release and beyond!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/842b9a465cf81c490660e45a68c70e50d226e53c.jpg[/img]

Getting to this moment has been nearly five years in the making, and we are excited to give our loyal Survivors a first look at Cypress Ridge. We are kicking things off through the release of a Steam Early Access version of SoH. We consider this version a sneak peak - or a Jump Scare - of what’s to come. 

Players will be able to access gameplay from our base of operations: Cypress Reel. Once the town’s movie theater, Cypress Reel is now a bustling headquarters for our scrappy Survivors.

At Cypress Reel, players will be able to switch between available Survivors, get acclimated to the game’s controls and weapons, redeem and customize clothing and cosmetics, and access the core modes SoH has to offer. During the sneak peek, two of our main modes, Raid and Invasion, will be fully playable both offline in single-player and online in co-op over the network. 

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/ad5e2d0ab0e225ccd508b8c83fc151b2dace04e9.jpg[/img]

[b]Raid Mode:[/b]  Save civilians and make it to the extraction point in this action-packed gauntlet.  Defeat enemies to find important weapons, ammo, and items, but don’t take too long; as you spend more time in one of many maps, enemies become stronger and deadlier.

[b]Invasion Mode:[/b]  The undead are closing in on your position, and you need to defend the innocent denizens of Cypress Ridge!  Fortify your defenses with buildable traps, turrets, and stations before hordes of zombies come to ruin your day.  Make sure you protect your Furos generators too, or else you’ll find yourself without the resources to stay alive as the action ramps up.  Enjoy unique modifiers that keep the experience fresh every round!

In between matches, stroll into the Cypress Reel Arcade to enjoy a host of frenetic mini-games!  Can you survive the [i]Boss Rush[/i] gauntlet? Will you be able to skip a creepy rural town in [i]Looming Dread[/i]?  Test your reflexes as you escape a flooding subway tunnel in [i]Collapse[/i]! While short and sweet, these mini-games will put your skills through drills!  Plus – with adjustable difficulties, there’s always new challenges to face.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/c48d365719bf5c5b408252cea7543c8126065e4e.jpg[/img]

Ten Survivors will be playable in the Sneak Peek. When playing as any character in any mode, your progress levels up that character and also helps complete challenges. You’ll earn XP, Ferret Tickets, new items and weapons, and other surprises as you play more and more!
While there are lots of free customizations to earn, Survivors also have a chance to earn Ferret Tickets. With these, you can shop at Ferret’s Emporium, the only remaining post-apocalyptic retailer in Cypress Ridge. Shirts, glasses, hats, weapon skins, and even whole outfits – you name it, Ferret’s Emporium has it all!  Redeem Ferret Tickets at Cypress Reel’s many gacha machines to earn and freely use all of them to customize each of your Survivors as you see fit.

Cypress Reel will evolve alongside [b]Shades of Horror[/b] as it grows and expands. You can look forward to seasonal and game-crossover events.  At the launch of SoH’s sneak peek, our first season will be Halloween, and our first DDS game-crossover will be with [b]DINOBREAK[/b]. You’ll be able to not only enjoy fun decorations in the theater, but also special challenges to complete, some with unique rewards.

But wait; there’s more! At the sneak peak’s launch, all players will have access to both the online multiplayer and the single-player, offline versions of [i]SoH: Chromatic Split[/i] and [i]Trials of Hank[/i].

[b]SoH: Chromatic Split:[/b]  Enjoy the classic, three act prequel to the main game, now enhanced with new weapons, items, and mechanics. Can Lydia get essential information from her contact in the Cypress Ridge underground before it’s too late?

[b]Trials of Hank: [/b] While Lydia is traversing the underground in [i]Chromatic Split[/i], fan-favorite Hank hits the rooftops in this over-the-top side campaign where the answers to all of life’s problems are lead, explosions, and more lead!  Will Hank complete his mission, or will the monsters that haunt the Cypress Ridge skyline be too much for him to handle?

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/ea3f6e3335c4bdd9f9a511675b0c2d707e0696ee.jpg[/img]

In our coming soon section: our [b]Story Mode[/b].  We need a bit more time before we’re ready to let you access our most ambitious campaign and narrative yet, and we’ll have more details about it when it’s closer to release. Please excuse our blood and dust, and thank you for your patience!

This is just the beginning of our roll-out for [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b].  In the future, the game will be available on Xbox Series and PlayStation 5 as previously announced. We do not yet have a timeframe for the console versions’ release, but you can expect to hear more details in the future.

The Early Access version of [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b] will launch for PC via Steam on [b]October 24th[/b] at a price-point of $29.99 USD.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/87d13c1cce7622072875d063a5b520cc342a2f48.jpg[/img]

Please stay tuned for more updates regarding [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b] and its development. We hope you’re excited to try the game starting on [b]October 24th[/b]!

See you out there, Survivors!

notes.title: March 2025 Update - Trailer & Modes Overview!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/59770769ab289361111794199201d10bb4b9bd4b.png[/img]

First, check out this new trailer: 

https://youtu.be/vtxiPu7Cr8Q

Today, we're going to break down the game's modes and hub area for you!  The entirety of [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b] can be experienced either solo or with up to three friends in co-op play over the network.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932190/Outbreak_Shades_of_Horror/

[b]Cypress Reel
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/9677a909a75b28e637ceb34b3a4f178b0716e163.png[/img]

This playground is where you and your friends can group up and enter the game's various modes!  You can select your character (across over 25 options!) and practice your controls, and you can also test your mettle at the obstacle course, improve your combat prowess, check out the game's various abilities and items, and so much more!  Over time, Cypress Reel will expand with new content and special events!

[b]Story mode
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/8512ba1729ba7b2e84ea19f68d7346be4a2cc8b3.jpg[/img]

This is the survival horror campaign you're all expecting!  Manage your resources and inventory, defeat menacing zombies, solve puzzles, and find notes as you explore colossal maps with awesome set-pieces and challenging encounters.  Each episode will play out in explosive fashion, with multiple routes and many secrets to discover.

[b]Invasion mode
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/2170722194b67491d86f8398c70ef68f36ced3bf.jpg[/img]

A different flavor of survival.  You'll face down endless enemy hordes as you attempt to both live and protect innocents.  Before the game begins, you have a small period of time to fortify your base with turrets, traps, and more.  Once the creatures appear, you'll need to annihilate hundreds of them without losing all of your lives or your civilians in the heat of battle.  Multiple maps will be available!

[b]Raid mode
[/b]

This arcade-style experience is a blast.  Scout sprawling, tight maps, take on the undead masses, and rescue trapped civilians before time runs out!  As with the rest of [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b], Raid mode will be updated with new content and maps over time.  Fans of our previous games may even find some fun nods to our history.

[b]Mini-games
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/7d7475934f99c250afa98975b54c30484bbe6e13.jpg[/img]

For some quick action, check out a selection of extra game types inspired by classic survival horror masterpieces.  From Boss Rush, where you'll face a parade of tough monsters, to Collapse, where you'll flee a nasty subway on the brink of destruction, these scenarios are fun to play through over and over.  Look forward to new mini-games as the game continues to grow!

We hope you're excited to experience the wild world of Cypress Ridge when [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b] begins its descent onto Xbox Series, PlayStation 5, and on PC via Steam this year!  We will of course continue to update you with the latest information and more specific release timing as development continues.  Thank you as always for your support and patience.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3107090/Outbreak_Shades_of_Horror_Chromatic_Split

[i]Chromatic Split[/i] is a standalone prologue to the upcoming [i]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/i] starring our hero Lydia Daniels.  Our detective enters the Cypress Ridge sewer system to meet with her contact on the eve of a massive zombie outbreak, and things quickly devolve from there.

Though initially unarmed, you will eventually find a melee weapon and firearms that allow you to progress through sprawling maps.  Items and resources are limited, so what you use them to craft, be it healing items, ammo, or save items, will be key to your survival.  Enemies can be strategically dismembered to make the most of your limited ammo, while massive boss creatures will require a lot more tenacity to finish off.

Explore the Cypress Ridge underground across a three act campaign, and then enjoy a variety of bonus modes and new game plus once you complete the game!  Post launch content will include additional bonus modes and the Trials of Hank, an extra side-campaign.

Gory survival horror gameplay meets glamorous graphics only possible with Unreal Engine 5 in [i]Outbreak: Shades of Horror Chromatic Split[/i], available now!

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 2 is now available on Steam!

- Improvements to eliminate a very infrequent situation where being grabbed by a zombie would remove your gun.
- Additional performance improvements across the title.
- Item highlights now appear at greater range.

The work on the game has also enhanced the map design and general gameplay for [i]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/i], as well. Stay tuned for more information on [i]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/i] in the future!

We have FOUR key categories to touch on today!

[b]1. New Elemental Weapons[/b]

If you tuned into our last stream, you may know a bit about these already!  The primary and secondary weapons in [i]Railbreak[/i] are outfitted with unique [b]elemental effects[/b] that can give you an advantage in battle.  Load up enemies with [b]electricity[/b] and watch them explode! Stop zombies in their tracks with [b]ice[/b] ammo! Melt through the undead with [b]fire[/b]! Send the body parts flying with [b]explosive rounds[/b]! The new elemental effects drive the action into absolutely chaotic territory, so be sure to take advantage of your arsenal!

[b]2. 'Glitch' Gameplay Modifier System[/b]

As you progress through the game, things may become a little dicey when new modifiers dubbed 'Glitches' trigger during a stage.  Some Glitches may lend a helping hand with [b]infinite ammo[/b] or a [b]defensive buff[/b], while others may serve as a thorn in your side with [b]enemies gaining additional health[/b] or a [b]storm of civilians[/b] running out in front of your shots. With a ton of different Glitches to encounter, you'll need to stay on your toes to survive!

[b]3. New Special Boss Zombies[/b]

On top of your run-of-the-mill zombies, keep your eyes out for powerful boss monsters! [b]Boom Boom[/b] will detonate itself if you're unable to kill it fast enough! The demonic [b]Fetch[/b] will blast and blind you with its powerful laser attack!  Things get even hairier when you encounter 'Glitched' versions of these beasts; these enhanced versions of the special infected have are faster, stronger, and tankier! 

[b]4. Three New Bonus Modes[/b]

Thought you knew all the ways you'd play [i]Railbreak[/i]? Think again! Deal with constantly firing and random Glitch modifiers in [b]Glitch Gauntlet[/b]! Face off against all of the game's bosses in a unique scenario in [b]Boss Rush[/b]! Face a special challenge that serves to thank our supporters in [b]Shoutout Shootout[/b]! With these new modes, you'll never run out of ways to play [i]Railbreak[/i] either alone or with a friend in optional two-player coop!

As the December 22nd release date for [i]Railbreak[/i] creeps ever closer, we're getting more and more excited for you to see our take on the on-rails arcade shooter genre!  Join us [b]tonight, December 13th[/b] [url=http://www.twitch.tv/deaddropstudios]on our Twitch channel[/url] at [b]7PM EST[/b] for a special stream showing off some of these new features! Welcome back to the world of survival horror in this hardcore, clunky, cheesy, and absurdly difficult adventure. Join Lydia as she tries to escape a city overrun with the undead, meeting fellow survivors, solving puzzles, battling the undead, and running for her life as everything tries to kill her.

You'll find no modern polish or game mechanics here. This is a '90s survival horror adventure as it was back then, all the rough edges intact including cheesy voice acting, limited saving, and non-stop death. So if you're ready to take a trip back in time for the ultimate challenge, there's no better time to face the nightmare. Just don't expect to kill a zombie in a single hit, they're quite durable!

And hey, you can always bring a friend along in split-screen co-op (or even online through Remote Play Together) if you really need some backup! Good luck! Oh, and bring a gamepad if you can, there's controller support!
